data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'zulikah' meaning 'graceful, beautiful, and elegant'. In the Bible, Zulika is the name of a woman who is described as having great beauty and grace. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zulika usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zulika total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
